about: Hermetic sliding door modelled as a product: steel opening lining and stainless face frame on the corridor face, leaf in a stainless edge profile with HPL core, perimeter gasket, vision panel with beads, vertical bar pull, kick plate, rounded track box with end caps, floor guide, foot sensor, push button and red/green interlock lamps.
